notes.title: DIG VR Digs Deeper – Now Available on PS VR2 and SteamVR!
notes.content:
Grab your hard hat and hi-vis jacket – DIG VR is officially breaking ground on PS VR2 and Steam VR! Already a hit on Meta Quest, this true-to-life excavator simulation game is now ready to deliver the immersive experience of heavy-duty machinery to even more VR platforms.

Whether you're a construction enthusiast, a sim lover, or just want to experience the strangely satisfying thrill of digging through dirt with powerful machines, DIG VR is your ticket to a rugged virtual playground.

You can grab DIG VR in the 'DIG VR x Tin Hearts' Bundle right now - at a discounted price! 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50266/DIG_VR_x_Tin_Hearts_Bundle/

Watch the Launch Trailer and step into the muddy boots of a pro excavator in the charmingly gritty world of Diglington, Digshire.

[previewyoutube=DMGmtUMLkeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What is DIG VR?[/h2]
DIG VR isn’t just another simulator – it’s a full-on excavation adventure. You’ll start out modestly, behind the controls of a mini-digger on your family’s farm, and work your way up to handling massive, high-powered machinery designed to take on the toughest terrain and trickiest jobs.

Whether you're mastering precision digging or powering through large-scale construction sites, DIG VR blends authenticity and fun in a way that's both challenging and deeply satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/06aaa89de2bf36118b20e97eed0a8a0a67014ed0.png[/img]

[h2]Features That Make DIG VR Stand Out:[/h2]
🔧 Authentic VR Simulation:
Choose between simplified and realistic control schemes to match your playstyle.

🚧 Career Mode:
Work your way from small jobs to becoming a seasoned machine operator in a full career campaign tailored for both casual players and serious sim fans.

🚜 Heavy Machinery Variety:
Control up to four different machines in various sizes, each designed for specific excavation needs.

🛠️ Unlock & Customize Tools:
Equip up to seven unique tool heads, including the Bucket, Breaker, Circular Saw, Auger, Trimmer, Compactor, and Grabber – and customize your digger with over 70 cosmetic upgrades like decals, paint jobs, and skins.

[h2]Available Now![/h2]
DIG VR is now out on PS VR2, and Steam VR, priced at £15.99 / $19.99 / €19.99 with 20% of for the first 2 weeks!  No matter where you dig, you're in for an authentic and immersive digging adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/03a496f8f368264e1d990fc762f784c1d16f5663.png[/img]

notes.title: The Hotel Architect Demo is now live!
notes.content:
The wait is over! Our demo is now available as part of Steam Next Fest. This is your chance to step into the shoes of a hotelier and design the ultimate guest experience. Whether you've been eagerly following the game's development or are just discovering it, the demo offers a hands-on preview of what it takes to build, manage, and customize a world-class hotel.  

For those new here: What is Hotel Architect & What should you expect in the Demo?  

Hotel Architect is a detailed hotel management simulation that allows you to craft unique and luxurious accommodations (or not... Your choice!). Juggle the increasingly elaborate demands of disorderly guests, logistical nightmares and unexpected obstacles in the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game.  

In this demo, you can explore two stunning destinations: the bustling city of Gothenburg and the sun-soaked shores of Santorini. Each location presents unique challenges and opportunities, encouraging you to think strategically as you design and manage your properties.  

[b]Key features of the demo include: [/b] 

[list] 

[*] Scenario and Sandbox Modes - Tackle structured objectives or unleash your creativity in open-ended play.  

[*] Customizable Hotel Designs - Design every aspect of your hotel, from room layouts to décor  

[*] Diverse Guest Types - Cater to different guest profiles, each with unique needs and expectations. 

[*] Operational Challenges - Manage staffing, amenities, and services to keep guests happy and your business thriving.  

[/list] 


[b]FAQ [/b] 

We also have a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1602000/discussions/0/596267508946698487/]frequently asked questions[/url] post in the discussion area on steam so you can get help if needed. This will be a work in progress, but please check there before posting as it’ll help manage the flow of questions incoming during the demo!   


[b]Content Creators playing Hotel Architect [/b] 

We also have a fantastic bunch of creators going live today and throughout Steam Next Fest, if you want to absorb more Hotel architect when you can't play yourself. Perhaps while working or travelling etc! Check out this list below:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37644815/81fc235bcd2e99b627ed0c073d8b0a26713c6190.jpg[/img]  

Well Good Luck & get building!  

We can't for you to try it out, and let us know what you think!  

P.S. If you haven't already, there is also a giveaway happening for playing the demo! head to [url=Wired.gg/HAgiveaway]Wired.gg/HAgiveaway[/url] to be in with the chance of winning some epic Razer Tech worth of $350 and Hotel Architect goodies!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37644815/7c81a5d7935f5809e789d84eb328cc24e4c27e63.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dig VR is coming to Steam VR!
notes.content:
Hold on to your hard hats, VR explorers! Our publisher, Wired Productions are telling us It's time to dig deep because DIG VR is making its way to Steam VR on March 20th!

Dig VR received critical acclaim on the Meta Quest, for it's sim-light gameplay, charming sense of humour and stunning soundtrack. So you better get ready as we’re excited to announce that you will soon be experiencing the thrill of digging, discovering, and, most importantly, getting a little dirty!

[previewyoutube=wxCaReZIXeU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What you can expect from Dig VR:[/h2]
Capturing the sheer joy, adrenaline and frustrations of life on a digger, DIG VR is an exciting experience for both novices and pros. Starting with nothing more than a mini-digger and a dream, players will work up to earning the keys to a colossal excavating machine with a diverse set of attachments to overcome the most challenging of jobs. Dig, delve, dredge, and discover the love of all things excavational in DIG VR!
[list]
[*] Choice of authentic & simplified controller schemes
[*] Full Career Mode Campaign with options for both serious & casual players
[*] Control powerful machinery, with up to 4 machines in a range of sizes
[*] Unlock up to 7 unique tool heads to attach to the digger. Which includes a bucket, Breaker, Circular Saw, Auger, Trimmer, Compactor and Grabber.
[*] Over 70 customisation options to unlock for your digger, including decal, paint & skins
[*] Play quirky mini-games, or enjoy the zen sandbox mode
[*] Featuring the first ever dynamic dig-able terrain in VR that can be dug, moved and dumped.
[/list]
[h2]So, are you ready to dig?[/h2]
DIG VR will be available on March 20th, so make sure to mark that date on your calendar, set a reminder, or let’s be honest, start digging out your virtual hard hat now. Don't forget you can wishlist as well! 
It’s going to be a groundbreaking (see what we did there!) release, and we can’t wait to see all of you join in on the digging fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2891460/DIG_VR/

notes.title: Tin Hearts Patch
notes.content:
Hello Tin Soldiers!

We have a delightful little patch dropping today. It has plenty of minor bug fixes and more.

The full list is below:

• Fixed a game-breaking issue in level 44 - Powerglove, now (always) with actual power!
• Several improvements and bug fixes in level 44 - Yes, we even fixed THAT bug. Oh, and it’s prettier too.
• Second Vac Tube in level 42 should no longer NOPE soldiers incorrectly.
• Albert should no longer get pinned between the trio of Cannons in level 37.
• Albert should no longer manifest as a ghost before he has finished ‘moving on.
• No more frozen soldier between block and paint cans in Level 7.
• The Tin Hearts logo sometimes would overstay its welcome in the Study level.
• Level 44 lighting improved.
• The powerglove reveal cutscene has been polished.
• Albert insisted climbing on non existent objects in Act 4 (I mean we know you’re a ghost and all that Albert, but c’mon).
• Jumping to Mr Soldier works as expected even when you have multiple Mr Soldiers (like in Level 44).
• Removed the superglue from the lift buttons in Level 44 so now Albert’s hand won’t stick to them after pressing.
• Elevated the zapper generator that was previously on the floor in Level 44. It was unhygienic (but it’s now also easier to spot).
• We discovered some invisible walls inside some of the stampers in Level 44? Possibly an attempt by the soldiers to stop them stamping? Sorry soldiers, can’t allow that.
• It is now more intuitive to route your soldiers to the first ladder in Level 44.
• Some spiders in Level 44 were not meeting The Guild of Toymakers’s quality bar for lethality. These spiders have been terminated and replaced with appropriately lethal ones.
• The puzzle in the middle level of Level 44 has been streamlined.
• Albert’s night vision goggles project is needed no more. Lack of adequate lighting in some level 44 areas has been addressed.
• Ghost airships when blowing them with pinwheels have been politely asked to behave a bit more predictably from now on.
• Loads of other minor bug fixes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/f16c5b7bf08ce369855aa5889ba46c3efec646b8.jpg[/img]

If for some reason you are having issues. Drop us some details over [url=https://wiredproductions.com/patch-notes/reports/][b]HERE.[/b][/url] It really helps get to the bottom of any problems you are having.

We hope this helps you to enjoy Tin Hearts even more than ever, but we will continue to polish and make it run smoother than an entire troop of marching soldiers.

If you have two minutes, please drop us a review. It massively helps with the visibility of the game.

Cheerio.

notes.title: Tin Hearts: Features & Mechanics
notes.content:
In the lead-up to the launch of Tin Hearts, we wanted to take a deep dive into the features and mechanics of this narrative puzzle adventure! Come and take a peak behind the curtain.

[h3]Embark on a trail of puzzles [/h3]
Solve increasingly elaborate puzzles by controlling toy cannons to clear the way ahead, bouncing to new heights using trampoline drums, and manipulating balloon-inflating machines! With a variety of ways to solve the puzzles, there are always new and imaginative ways to help your soldiers reach their destination! Link objects in interesting ways as you build paths to the exit for your fearless tin soldiers to follow, and slowly reveal the secrets of their past.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/4f0613deff8686565910a22efa03956162ebeb81.png[/img]

[h3]Unravel the Story[/h3]
Tin Hearts takes you through the life and journey of Albert J. Butterworth, a genius inventor and toy maker in Victorian times. Told through the subtle clues in the environment and immersive cutscenes, Tin Hearts weaves all of this into the fabric of the puzzle-filled world of the Butterworth family’s home. 

Clues are everywhere, seek them out and you will be rewarded with a heartfelt tale! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/6f34d1c33599d432e30b01f2c603f51d3bd6427f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Explore a magical world [/h3]
Full of nostalgic warmth and charm, Tin Hearts makes you feel like a child in a toy store. Fully immersive, Tin Hearts dives you into a magical, alternate-timeline Victorian universe. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/f0a31dc435485e8779f11c695c4c5b879a69049d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Manipulate time [/h3]
Pause, fast-forward and rewind time using the Cuckoo Clock or Pocketwatch to change the outcomes of your actions or prevent danger from befalling the soldiers at all! This will help you in your goal to complete the increasingly intricate puzzles and guide the soldiers to safety. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/4ed6d7eb41c6ed60c36616713b8f4d4d7879f3af.png[/img]

[h3]Enjoy the memorable soundtrack [/h3]
Award-winning composer, Matthew Chastney, whose credits include trailers for ‘Joker’, ‘Chernobyl’, and ‘Bridgerton’ has created a moving soundtrack for Tin Hearts, with music to warm (and sometimes break) your heart. Take your time working through the relaxing puzzles, while listening to the poignant soundtrack. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/fc1d8346f04eead0eb5df12b75c13d56e8ef7acd.jpg[/img]

[h3]From the developers of Fable [/h3]
Brought to you by former members of the exceptionally talented Lionhead Studios team, responsible for the critically acclaimed Fable series. Keep an eye out for the hidden chickens throughout Tin Hearts, a subtle hint that the legacy of Fable flows throughout this game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/208c1d270b92593ff90a1bdc76641ba7808f1e26.png[/img]

Thank you for taking a look into the mechanics and features of Tin Hearts, but if you would like to go behind the scenes. Check out our making of Documentary series: [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL2oxQvg7jc1koNbqH_KcQZEokcxPzATzz]The Heart of It.[/url]

Tin Hearts will be released on Nintendo Switch on April 20th, 2023 with Steam, PlayStation 4 & 5, and the Xbox family of consoles to release one month later on May 16th, 2023. 
PCVR, Meta Quest 2 and PSVR2 are set to be released later this year.

The Tin Hearts Closed Beta is now live on Steam. Running from the 10th at 6 pm GMT to midnight on the 14th of February. Happy Valentine's day!

Apply for a Tin hearts beta code [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSesbVO8NMNB3DAjL_CccgcOZuaC4n2mfgpo8iWXvuOo4dlEvA/viewform?usp=sf_link]HERE![/url]

The beta will be the first chance to experience the opening Acts of Tin Hearts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/7d25ad41bb699bc601a473483112465c2de1911c.jpg[/img]

Known issues in the beta are:
[list]
[*] Camera placement for the canon view can be awkward. (Unpredictable camera? must be a loose canon)
[*] Players are able to stand on Rose's bed. (They could at least take their shoes off first.)
[*] Some doors and windows are missing in house scenes. (This is just a pane.)
[*] Restarting after the music room will cause the player to have to restart the music room level. (We will refrain from making a pun and a tone.)
[/list]
Join the Tin Hearts Discord to share solutions and screenshots. Discord is the home to our exclusive content, such as early concept art, Level design and more. you can speak directly with the Rogue Sun developers about the game. Click the link below to join:

[h2][url=https://discord.com/invite/7Crp433qUv][b]Tin Hearts Discord[/b][/url][/h2]

(Early soldier design)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/ede1f8fa651c21e1e49a4962d8edd7f3eb322e68.jpg[/img]

(Early-level design)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/fc1d8346f04eead0eb5df12b75c13d56e8ef7acd.jpg[/img]

Behind every brilliant invention, hides a magical story. From members of the team that brought you Fable, comes Tin Hearts – an immersive puzzle adventure game wrapped in a powerful tale of love and compromise.

Guide a troop of mischievous tin soldiers through a magical toy-filled world using a variety of whimsical and inventive contraptions to bounce, shoot and glide them to their goal. March through 40+ levels of time-bending, soldier-routing riddles, forge new paths for your toys to follow, and solve increasingly elaborate puzzles to unravel the emotional, thought-provoking story, of Albert J. Butterworth, a genius inventor of Victorian times.
